checks.finding: All seven final runtime files match the exact final manifest bytes and hashes.
The shared brace reader is used for template calls, triple-brace parameters, top-level pipe splitting and syntax diagnostics, without introducing a generic brace-balancing repair.
Known template identities require separately recorded literal spellings. Unknown, dynamic, parser-function and magic-word names retain their previous lookup path.
Template definition, documentation and test contexts disable unrelated article transformations. The original template opt-in flag is serialized into Worker options and included in freshness tracking.

Finite definition plans preserve values, argument order, accepted aliases, absent versus empty defaults and source-bound proof. Duplicate handling refuses conflicting values and respects the last binding.
TemplateData handling rejects duplicate JSON keys and unsupported schemas. Existing parameter declaration order and metadata values remain distinct from implementation semantics.

CSS application requires read-only native sanitizer results bound to source and candidate, selectors, at-rule context, values, priority, cascade order and duplicate multiplicity. Stale editor state cannot apply a proposal.

The inherited eligibility conjunction admits every value except 33 exact recorded strings. It changes 156 originally positive generated decisions per bundle. Original positive assertion bodies and negative assertions remain in the historical source.
The finite identity contract contains 204 static canonical and invalid endpoint pairs. The expected endpoints and eligibility function do not use production identity helpers.

The documentation generator requires completed QA bound to the exact runtime manifest before describing results, preserves published historical entries and distinguishes synthetic cases from distinct articles.

Reader evidence contains one successful complete native response and 48 official upstream oracle cases. The planned 143-case fresh capture is explicitly incomplete and is not claimed as executed coverage.

A separately declared finite documented-title projection corrects 324 generated positive source inputs per bundle. Exact original assertion bodies, fields, values and all negative assertions are retained; every original invalid input has a refusal check.

The amended full inherited main passed 30,339 cases, 225,295 checks and 57 reports under its actual amended plan. Earlier complex, large and browser receipts retain their actual plan bindings. The separate documentation-only bridge proves identical executable and compiled test bytes.

The final documentation generator distinguishes the pinned 2.14.0 runtime base from the retained 2.13.0 historical benchmark, and the test documentation distinguishes eligibility deltas, generated-title source corrections and the later README-only metadata transition.
